name: Fire Burst
body:
School evocation [fire]; Level sorcerer/wizard 9

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M (a lump of sulfur and a tindertwig)

EFFECT

Range personal
Area 25-ft. radius, centered on you
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw Reflex half; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

Flames burst out in a 25-foot radius circle around you. You are unharmed, but all others within the burst take 10d8 points of fire damage. All combustibles within the burst are ignited, and creatures that remain in the area take an additional 1d8 fire damage until the flames are put out.
